signatures.eigenvalue_determinant_semantics: (n : ℕ) (A : RealMatrix n) (lam : ℝ) : HasRealEigenvalue A lam ↔ characteristicDet A lam = 0
signatures.family_and_determinant_semantics: : EntrywiseLE lower upper ∧ (∀ A : RealMatrix 3, InIntervalFamily lower upper A ↔ ∃ a b : ℝ, a ∈ Set.Icc (-166) (-16) ∧ b ∈ Set.Icc 9 159 ∧ A = family a b) ∧ (∀ a b lam : ℝ, characteristicDet (family a b) lam = (lam - 25) * (lam ^ 2 - 1) - a * (lam - 1) - b * (lam + 1))
signatures.witness_eigenpairs: (i : Fin 4) : InIntervalFamily lower upper (family (includedA i) (includedB i)) ∧ includedVector i ≠ 0 ∧ (family (includedA i) (includedB i)).mulVec (includedVector i) = includedValue i • includedVector i ∧ includedValue i ∈ realEigenvalueSet lower upper
signatures.witness_separators: : (∀ A : RealMatrix 3, InIntervalFamily lower upper A → ∀ j : Fin 3, determinantLower j ≤ characteristicDet A (separator j) ∧ characteristicDet A (separator j) ≤ determinantUpper j) ∧ (∀ j : Fin 3, determinantUpper j < 0) ∧ (∀ j : Fin 3, separator j ∉ realEigenvalueSet lower upper)
signatures.connected_component_intervals: (S : Set ℝ) (x y : S) (h : ConnectedComponents.mk x = ConnectedComponents.mk y) : Set.Icc (x : ℝ) (y : ℝ) ⊆ S
signatures.four_components: : (∃ f : Fin 4 → realEigenvalueSet lower upper, (∀ i, (f i : ℝ) = includedValue i) ∧ Function.Injective (fun i => ConnectedComponents.mk (f i))) ∧ (4 : Cardinal) ≤ componentCard (realEigenvalueSet lower upper)
signatures.counterexample: : EntrywiseLE lower upper ∧ (3 : Cardinal) < componentCard (realEigenvalueSet lower upper)
